name: Fig toast
intro: Thick sourdough, torn burrata, ripe figs, honey, flaky salt. The best five-minute dinner of the summer.

variations.context: The default. Burrata, figs, honey, salt.
Thin slices of leftover chop under the figs.
A few rings of jalapeño over the figs. Strange and very good.

finish: Toast the bread in a skillet with olive oil until crisp. Tear the burrata over it while it's hot so it starts to soften, then the figs, a thread of honey, and flaky salt.
